name: auth0-whoami-mcp-template
description: Forkable Auth0 Custom Extension MCP template with a whoami tool.

scripts.build: rimraf dist build/bundle.js && node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs && esbuild src/webtask.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --external:edge --external:superagent-proxy --outfile=dist/extension.js && mkdir -p build && cp dist/extension.js build/bundle.js && node scripts/create-extension-package.mjs && zip -j -q dist/package.zip dist/extension.js dist/package.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs
